title: Did Buddy Petit play that style?
summary: Miller says Buddy played a nice horn and got more tone, but is unsure about this style.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Did Buddy play at all?

No, Buddy played all. He played a nice home. Mm-hmm. I ain't sure like Buddy played this sort of thing. I don't know. Bucket got a hold of him. That's a piece I used to play for him to play. Mm-hmm. He gets more tone out of it, you know. Mm-hmm.
